title: Car-O-Liner CAR-O-DATA vehicle measurement database
notes: Official materials describe CAR-O-DATA and Vision2 as a professional database for upper and lower body measurement, fixture selection and target tolerances. The public pages do not expose individual vehicle sheets and did not confirm a Porsche 993 record. Verify coverage with an authorised Car-O-Liner user before any purchase. Re-checked on 2026-10-15 for issue #10: the product page https://car-o-liner.com/product/car-o-data/ states coverage of more than 18,000 vehicles 'Supplied as a yearly service subscription', with 'Request Quote' and 'Find A Distributor' as the only routes; no public vehicle list or model search, and no mention of Porsche. The 993 is still not publicly confirmed, which does not show it is absent. Subscribing, or asking a subscribed workshop for a 993 sheet and its reuse terms, is an owner decision.
